title: Evaluation of a represented Ext class under a right derived functor
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a chosen derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], enough injectives [def-sp-enough-injectives], K-injective resolutions, and Ext groups in universe $u+1$, interpreted as the chosen small presentation of the shifted derived Hom groups. Let $P:C\to\mathrm{Ab}_{u+1}$ be additive and left exact, with its canonical total right derived functor and single-object cohomology comparison [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility]. For $A,B\in C$, $q\in\mathbb N$, $g\in P(A)$, and $x\in\operatorname{Ext}^q(A,B)$, define the derived evaluation of $x$ at $g$ to be the following element of $H^q(RP(B[0]))$. Carry $g$ back through the canonical isomorphism $H^0(RP(A[0]))\simeq P(A)$, apply $H^0$ of $RP$ of the represented morphism $x:A[0]\to B[0][q]$, then apply the canonical shift comparison $RP(B[0][q])\simeq RP(B[0])[q]$ and the cohomology shift isomorphism $H^0(RP(B[0])[q])\simeq H^q(RP(B[0]))$. Finally apply the canonical identification of the derived single object with the localization of its single cochain complex, so that the target is literally the localization-based presentation of $H^q(RP(B[0]))$. All comparisons are the existing derived-functor constructions.
